values.note: 2026, 30-50 amp sites: water and electric $37 Sunday to Thursday and $47 Friday and Saturday; with sewer too $40 and $50; holidays $57-60 with a 3-night minimum. Full-hookup sites by the week $260 ($285 a holiday week) or by the month $725 plus electric. Rates cover 2 adults and the family's children; other guests $5 a day. Card payments carry a 4% handling fee.

note: Family campground, in business since 1966, under mature oaks beside the Cedar River, with a pool and tent sites along the river. Mostly seasonal: on the operator's map about 19 RV sites sell by the night (back-ins 4-5, 51-54 and 59-63, pull-throughs 82-88, and site 96), plus two group areas; the other numbered sites are seasonal. --Claude
summary: Operator site, rates and map read: 2026 rates $37-50 confirmed, sewer added to hookups, facilities written, reservation by request form or phone. The map shows the park is mostly seasonal (~19 nightly RV sites of ~125); it passes the five long-stay tests (~15% nightly). Not waterfront kept; the note's 'creek' corrected to the Cedar River.
flags: LONG-STAY (passes, report): the operator's map legend marks most numbered sites 'Seasonal Sites'; the nightly RV sites are back-ins 4, 5, 51-54, 59-63 and pull-throughs 82-88 ('20/30/50 amp w/ sewer & water') and site 96 ('20/30 amp w/ water'), about 19 of ~125 RV sites (~15%), plus two group areas and a tent area. Five tests: (1) $37 base, under $50; (2) nightly rate on its own site plus phone, reservations by request form or phone with no application or lease; (3) only the 3-night holiday minimum; (4) ~15% nightly, over 1 in 10; (5) not a home community. Keep, with the note saying it is mostly seasonal.
PRIVATE GATES: Google 4.6 with 186 reviews; phone 507-583-2979 confirmed on the site and Google; rate dated 2026. Pass.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The map's riverside sites are the 'Riverview Tenting Area' (tents) and seasonal sites 45-50; no nightly RV site is on the Cedar River, and imagery shows the river behind a wooded band.
SEASON: the site says only 'Closed During Winter Until Mid-April'; no closing date, so season not written.
Pin 43.82158,-93.00083 is in the main loop; Google's point 43.81978,-93.00067 is the office/entrance ~200 m S. OK.
